class.name: LiveConfig
class.brief_description: Values you change on the online services without shipping an update.
class.description: Live config holds values the game reads that you change on your online services instance with [code]npm run live-config[/code]: feature flags, a switch to turn something off, tuning numbers, a seasonal event's dates. Give each key its default in Project Settings, as [code]live_config/<key>[/code], so the game works offline and before the first values arrive: [codeblock] var bonus = LiveConfig.get_value("tip_bonus", 1.0) LiveConfig.changed.connect(func(): bonus = LiveConfig.get_value("tip_bonus", 1.0)) [/codeblock] Values come from the online services ([code]online/url[/code]) the first time the game asks for one, then every 15 minutes and whenever the game comes back to the front. A value can be scheduled, with a start and an end: the game switches to it and back on time, by the service's clock rather than the device's. The last values are kept on the device, so a game started offline has them. No sign-in is needed: the values are the same for every player.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the key's value now: the online services' if one is in effect, else [code]live_config/<key>[/code] in Project Settings, else [param default]. Values are what JSON holds: numbers come as [float], and lists and objects as [Array] and [Dictionary].

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once values have come from the online services, in this run or kept from an earlier one.

method.name: refresh
method.description: Asks the online services for the values now, rather than waiting for the next time. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code], and on failure [code]error[/code] and [code]message[/code] ([code]not_configured[/code] without [code]online/url[/code]). [signal changed] fires first if any value changed.

signal.name: changed
signal.description: Emitted when a value changes: new values came from the online services, or a scheduled one started or ended.
